attributes.additional_details: Our experience thankfully didn't hurt us but it's completely shaken us up and could have been 10 times worse
attributes.background: I would like to start a petition and ban all fireworks for display purposes only after a terrifying experience on the 30th October that left my children traumatized after silly teenage children thinking there wanna be gangsters threw fireworks directly at myself and family also passing cars .

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893
